description: Introducing Series 1 of the Rare Pepe Collection! 150 Pepe packs available with hit favorites such as RAREPEPE, HAIRPEPE, LORDKEK, and more! Will you collect all 50 cards in the set? Only 150 packs created in the 10 year anniversary print. This set is an unofficial Pepe product created for the enjoyment of having physical Pepe cards in the world. Available for pickup at the Bitcoin 2026 conference in Las Vegas. Message @TrustyPinocchio on X for more information.
name: PEPEPACKS
